description: Natural gas production by municipality is a dataset listed in Alberta open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Jobs, Economy and Northern Development. Lists natural gas production by year and municipal district. Natural gas production includes the production of of raw gas or marketable gas or any constituent of raw gas, condensate, crude bitumen or crude oil that is recovered in processing and that is gaseous at the conditions under which its volume is measured or estimated. Coverage: Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Jobs, Economy and Northern Development. Its tags are Alberta Regional Dashboard, municipal districts, natural gas, natural gas production. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, URI, XLSX, XML. The portal shows 2023-06-08 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-alberta-portal.
